prompt: Build a minimal cashier (POS) single-page app in the current workspace. No network access and no external dependencies. 1) data.js must export a constant PRODUCTS: an array of at least 4 products, each an object with id (non-empty string), name (non-empty string) and price (a positive number, in yuan). 2) cart.js must export pure functions operating on a cart (an array of { id, qty }); every function must return new values and never mutate its arguments: addItem(cart, products, id, qty = 1) adds qty of the product and, when the id is already in the cart, increases its qty; throw Error("unknown product") for an id not present in products and Error("invalid qty") when qty is not a positive integer. setQty(cart, products, id, qty) sets the qty of an existing item and removes the item when qty is 0; throw Error("unknown product") for unknown ids and Error("invalid qty") for negative or non-integer qty. removeItem(cart, id) removes the item and returns the cart unchanged when the id is unknown. cartTotal(cart, products) returns the sum of price × qty over all items, rounded to cents, so 0.1 + 0.2 must equal 0.3. checkout(cart, products, paid) returns { total, change } where total is cartTotal and change is paid − total rounded to cents; throw Error("insufficient payment") when paid < total. 3) index.html is a single page that loads data.js and cart.js via script tags and contains elements with id="product-list", id="cart" and id="total", plus a checkout button. Do not modify check.mjs. The harness runs check.mjs after you finish.

files.data.js:

export const PRODUCTS = [];
